prompt: A young woman with a red bandana pulled over her nose and mouth stands in the center foreground, facing the viewer, holding a burning red road flare high over her head that throws red light and sparks across her face and jacket. Behind her a crowd of protesters with raised fists and red armbands surges forward, and beyond them a dark wall of faceless riot police with tall shields and visored helmets blocks a city street under concrete apartment blocks. Woodcut print style with thick carved black ink lines on cream paper, only three flat colors: cream, black ink and bright red, with the flare and bandanas as the only red. Hard high-contrast light from the flare, strong graphic silhouettes, and a calm empty band of cream sky across the top quarter.
